synopsis.text: The Beast is attacked by a group of costumed criminals armed with high tech weapons!
Despite the cover promise of the Squadron Sinister, the team featured are actually the Squadron Supreme! The same mistake is made in a few issues time.

First George Perez Avengers and only his second book. his first was Astonishing Tales (Deathlok #25 (1974) 2-pages humor strip, Pérez' first published work for Marvel or anyone. his style hadn't gelled yet but by his next issue Perez was already getting a mastery of drawing.
Features the Hostess Fruit Pies ad, The Incredible Hulk And The Twins Of Evil!
